mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or signal Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of INDPRO > 100.0 periods during late-cycle expansions, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate below 0.25% triggers immediate equity market reaction as investors anticipate prolonged easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of FEDFUNDS < 0.25 instances, or signal Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal systemic economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates strengthening supply chains that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of INDPRO > 95.0 periods during post-recession recovery, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.
